CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  February 27, 2024
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  SAL MEDINA
  MAYOR

  JED LEANO  ED REECE  COREY CALAYCAY  JENNIFER STARK

Meetings are open to the public for in-person attendance. The meeting will be live streamed via Zoom,
technology permitting. Members of the public will not be able to provide public comment via Zoom. To
watch the meeting via Zoom, use the following link: https://zoom.us/j/256208090. To listen via telephone
dial (213)338-8477, Webinar ID: 256 208 090. The recorded meeting will be uploaded to the City
website and archived.

  OPTIONS FOR PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment may be provided by one of the following methods. Each speaker will be given up to
three (3) minutes to provide their comment.

  IN-PERSON LIVE COMMENTS

When the item you wish to speak to is announced, please proceed to the speaker’s podium one by one.

  E-MAIL/MAIL

Written comments sent to the City Clerk’s office will be distributed to the City Council and imaged into
the record of the meeting. Email: sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. Mail:
PO Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. Written comments submitted after publication of the agenda will be
made available in the document archive system on the City website as soon as possible -
www.ci.claremont.ca.us.

  For assistance, comments, or more information please contact the City Clerk’s Office:
  (909) 399-5461 or (909) 399-5463.

Council Item
1.  APPOINTMENT  OF  A  MEMBER  TO  THE  COMMUNITY  AND  HUMAN  SERVICES
  COMMISSION
  Recommendation:  The 2023 City Council Ad Hoc Selection Committee recommends the City
  Council appoint Russ Binder to the Community and Human Services
  Commission for a term to commence immediately and terminate August 31,
  2027.

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City website :
www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointments.

CITY MANAGER REPORT

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons who wish to comment on items that are not listed
 Page 3  City Council Agenda  February 27, 2024

on the agenda, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council. Members of the public will have
the opportunity to address the City Council regarding all items on the agenda at the time the
Council considers those items.

General public comment will be taken for 30 minutes and will resume later in the meeting if there
are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the 30-minute time limit.

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine. The City Council may act on
these items by one motion following public comment. Only Councilmembers may pull an item from
the Consent Calendar for discussion, reading of resolutions and ordinances will be waived.
2.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING CITY WARRANT REGISTERS
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ALLOWING
  CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYIING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID, dated February 15, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated February 15, 2024

3.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF FEBRUARY 13, 2024 (SPECIAL AND REGULAR)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council approve the special and regular City
  Council meeting minutes of February 13, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Special Meeting Minutes of February 13, 2024
  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of February 13, 2024

4.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING WILLDAN FINANCIAL SERVICES TO
  PREPARE THE 2024-25 LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING DISTRICT ANNUAL REPORT
  (FUNDING SOURCE: LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING DISTRICT FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, DIRECTING
  WILLDAN FINANCIAL SERVICES, AS ENGINEER OF RECORD, TO
  PREPARE AND FILE THE 2024-25 ANNUAL REPORT PERTAINING TO
  LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING DISTRICT NO. LL001 (PURSUANT TO THE
  LANDSCAPE AND LIGHTING ACT OF 1972).
  Attachment(s):  Proposed Resolution
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  February 27, 2024

5.  AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH FIRST CLASS HEATING AND
  AIR CONDITIONING, INC. FOR EMERGENCY BOILER REPLACEMENT SERVICES AT THE
  CLAREMONT POLICE DEPARTMENT (FUNDING SOURCE: EQUIPMENT AND FACILITY
  REVOLVING RESERVE)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with First Class
  Heating and Air Conditioning, Inc. in the amount of $43,350.37 for
  emergency boiler replacement services; and
  B. Appropriate $43,350.37 from the Equipment and Facility Revolving
  Reserve to fully fund the emergency boiler replacement.
6.  AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH MUSCO SPORTS LIGHTING,
  LLC. FOR SPORTS FIELD LIGHTING CONTROL UPGRADES (FUNDING SOURCE: YOUTH
  SPORTS COMMITTEE SELF-IMPOSED USER IMPROVEMENT FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into
  an agreement with Musco Sports Lighting, LLC. in the amount of $29,980.50
  for the purchase, installation, and support of Control-Link systems at La
  Puerta Sports Park and Larkin Park.
  Attachment(s):  Musco Sports Lighting, LLC Control-Link System Quote
  Excerpt from the 12-19-23 Youth Sports Committee Meeting Minutes (Draft)

7.  2023 HOMELESS SERVICES UPDATE (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND, AMERICAN
  RESCUE PLAN ACT FUND, AND MEASURE H FUNDING)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the  2023 Homeless
  Services Update.

PUBLIC HEARINGS - None

ORDINANCES - None

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEM
8.  CONSIDERATION  OF  (1)  A  RESOLUTION  AFFIRMING  THE  CITY  COUNCIL’S
  LONG-STANDING  PRACTICE  OF  NOT  ADOPTING  RESOLUTIONS  OR  ISSUING
  PROCLAMATIONS THAT TAKE AN OFFICIAL CITY POSITION ON SOCIAL OR POLITICAL
  ISSUES THAT ARE NOT LOCAL TO CLAREMONT, AND (2) A RESOLUTION CALLING FOR
  AN IMMEDIATE PEACEFUL RESOLUTION TO THE ONGOING CONFLICT AND
  HUMANITARIAN CRISIS IMPACTING GAZA AND ISRAEL.
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, AFFIRMING THE
  CITY COUNCIL'S LONG-STANDING PRACTICE OF NOT ADOPTING
  RESOLUTIONS OR ISSUING PROCLAMATIONS THAT TAKE AN OFFICIAL
  CITY POSITION ON SOCIAL OR POLITICAL ISSUES THAT ARE NOT
  LOCAL TO CLAREMONT.

MARCH 12, 2024, AT 6:30 PM, IN THE CLAREMONT COUNCIL CHAMBER, 225 WEST SECOND
STREET, CLAREMONT, CA 91711.
